answers.how: Fitting the apple’s vertical fall gives about 2810 px/s². Gravity therefore sets the scale at 287 px/m; the apple’s diameter is about 28 px.
The tabletop is about 285 px above the floor. Dividing by the gravity-derived scale of 287 px/m gives the height.
During free fall, the apple moves horizontally about 63 px in 0.325 s. Converting with 287 px/m gives its horizontal speed.
The fitted trajectory lasts about 0.45 s from leaving the tabletop to first floor contact. At about 194 px/s horizontally, it travels 87 px, converted using 287 px/m.
